name: sidenote
description: Read, search and edit your Sidenote notepads.

interface.longDescription: Sidenote is a notes app that lives in Chrome's side panel. Connect it to search, read and edit your notepads from here: find what you wrote, add to a list, tick off to-dos, draft a new notepad or subpad, star or archive. You sign in with your Sidenote sync key on Sidenote's own page; this app never sees the key. Choose read-only access if it should never change anything. Nothing is deleted through this app.
